notes.title: The ARC INDIE Update!
notes.notes:
​We're excited to share that Lloyd the Monkey 3: Judgement Day will be at this year's ARC INDIE Expo next week, with a new update to mark the occasion! Tweaks we've made here include:

Adjusting the timing of projectile attacks to prevent (or at least minimizing) player projectiles colliding with each other.
Implementing a raycast into the programming of Lloyd's wall jump, hopefully improving the rhythm required to use the move.
Made a fix for the final boss battle's opening cutscene that improves the intended characterization of Lloyd.
Athletic clothes were added for Lura, based on her design from Lloyd the Monkey 2.
Another update will be coming along within the next couple months, and it'll likely be much bigger. Look forward to it!

notes.title: The SAGE 2024 Update!
notes.notes:
Hope everyone's having a good time with Lloyd the Monkey 3: Judgement Day on Steam! With SAGE 2024 coming along at Sonic Fan Games HQ, I thought it'd be appropriate to put out the first of what I hope will be several updates to improve the game experience for everyone! To start things off with this update:

We fixed a bug that causes a piece of the giant gorilla boss to spawn when revisiting Byzantium.
Subtitles for the FMV sequences are implemented in both languages. Still working on the timing.
The sundress was implemented as a custom wardrobe option for Lura. This is the outfit she wore in the original Lloyd the Monkey game.


There will be more updates to come, so follow the community hub so you're posted on the tweaks and improvements. And we look forward to hearing your thoughts on future patches!
